gloss: to lower, to take down, to withdraw

definitions.explanation: To move something from a higher to a lower position.
To let someone out of a vehicle.
To take money from an account.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}で{下|お}ろしてください。
examples.english: Please drop me off at the station.

examples.japanese: {銀行|ぎんこう}でお{金|かね}を{下|お}ろした。
examples.english: I withdrew money at the bank.

notes:
{下|お}ろす has multiple uses.

COMMON USES:
- {荷物|にもつ}を{下|お}ろす: to unload luggage
- お{金|かね}を{下|お}ろす: to withdraw money
- {客|きゃく}を{下|お}ろす: to drop off a passenger

TRANSITIVITY:
- {下|お}ろす (transitive): to lower
- {下|お}りる (intransitive): to descend

OTHER MEANINGS:
- {卸|おろ}す: to sell wholesale (different kanji)
